code='''def transform(grid):
    """Return the cellwise overlap of the two panels split by a solid line."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A solid nonzero row or column is the separator. Panels on either side
    # have the same dimensions; mark overlaps with color 2.
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        v = grid[r][0]
        if v != 0 and all(x == v for x in grid[r]):
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(a) == len(b) and len(a) > 0:
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0
                         for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        v = grid[0][c]
        if v != 0 and all(row[c] == v for row in grid):
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            if len(left[0]) == len(right[0]) and len(left[0]) > 0:
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0
